today.q: How do you distinguish between modeled supply potential and actual service delivery across different urban governance contexts?
outline: Define modeled supply using tools like InVEST versus actual human benefits
Discuss how demand and service flows mediate between supply and delivery
Contrast formal development settings with informal settlements
today.pitfall: Confusing potential ecological capacity with actual human consumption or well-being benefits.
today.follow_up: How does this distinction shift when evaluating access to urban nature in conflict-affected data-scarce cities?
today.bring: Comparative frameworks separating ecological potential from realized benefits using service flow cascades.
self_check: Maintains theoretical distinction without assuming empirical results
